Done when (acceptance): One signed checklist covers candidate, employer, resume, application and paid-course exclusions.
Initial real jobs and internships have consent, working apply path, expiry and owner contact.

Deliverable / task: Publish privacy, terms, support and FAQ copy
Done when (acceptance): Footer links reach accurate pages; support inbox/process and response owner are defined.
Pilot issues triaged; P0 defects closed; metrics, support and rollback owners agree to launch.
Only authorized employer/admin publishes; invalid/expired/demo listings stay off candidate surfaces.

Deliverable / task: Make apply flow safe and status consistent
Done when (acceptance): Duplicate apply is blocked; candidate sees Applied; employer sees the same application record/status.
Job/internship lists paginate, filter and sort reliably; empty/error states are deterministic.
Explain/profile key queries; slow paths fixed against pilot-size data and measured again.
Home and listing pages show only live opportunities; filters/detail work on phone and desktop.
Applied button is disabled on job and internship cards/details; status persists after refresh/login.
From listing to resume choice to apply confirmation requires no dead end on mobile.

Deliverable / task: Hide paid courses across launch UI
Done when (acceptance): No paid-course card, nav item, recommendation, pricing or checkout CTA is visible to launch users.
Tests cover account, search, listing detail, job-tailored resume, apply, duplicate apply and employer review.
Core flow works in current Chrome/Safari and small screens; keyboard/forms have no blocker.
Candidate cannot access employer data; untrusted upload and expired-session cases are tested.

Deliverable / task: Own pilot triage and bug board
Done when (acceptance): Each pilot defect has severity, owner and reproduction; P0 issues block release.
Candidate can create or upload resume, edit key fields and retain data across sessions.
Selected job requirements inform suggestions; user reviews edits before saving or applying.
Exported PDF matches preview; version tied to the chosen job is selectable in apply flow.

Deliverable / task: Handle missing job data and AI failure
Done when (acceptance): User gets useful manual suggestions and can finish resume/apply if generation times out or fails.

Deliverable / task: Create CI and staging release path
Done when (acceptance): Every merge runs build/tests; staging mirrors required config and has a documented deploy owner.

Deliverable / task: Add errors, latency and application metrics
Done when (acceptance): Alerts/boards show auth failure, API errors, slow routes and apply success rate without exposing PII.
Run agreed traffic scenario for search/detail/apply; record p95, error rate and bottlenecks; rerun after fixes.
Restore drill passes in staging; deploy rollback steps and responsible person are recorded.
